sources.orderUse: When buyer supplies a 지번주소, the legal ri can help clarify the recipient address. Does not prove individual building address, branch, delivery performance, or unique fulfillment constraints.
An address described using an administrative ri may need a legal ri and road/building number to avoid ambiguity; do not infer customer's address.
